name: auto-shop-owned::HML Technical Health
description: Owned by auto-shop-system. Aggregate HML health only; no raw logs or personal data.

widgets.title: FastAPI throughput (requests/min)
widgets.nrql: FROM Transaction SELECT rate(count(*), 1 minute) WHERE appName = 'auto-shop-api' AND label.environment = 'hml' TIMESERIES SINCE 30 minutes ago

widgets.title: FastAPI availability and error rate (%)
widgets.coverage_note: No traffic is no data, not 100% availability.
widgets.nrql: FROM Transaction SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE error IS false) AS 'availability', percentage(count(*), WHERE error IS true) AS 'error rate' WHERE appName = 'auto-shop-api' AND label.environment = 'hml' SINCE 30 minutes ago

widgets.title: FastAPI latency p50/p95/p99 (seconds)
widgets.nrql: FROM Transaction SELECT percentile(duration, 50, 95, 99) WHERE appName = 'auto-shop-api' AND label.environment = 'hml' TIMESERIES SINCE 30 minutes ago

widgets.title: API Gateway volume and errors (count/5 min)
widgets.coverage_note: AWS polling is aggregate and normally arrives every five minutes.
widgets.nrql: FROM ApiGatewaySample SELECT sum(provider.count), sum(provider.4xxError), sum(provider.5xxError) WHERE stage = 'hml' TIMESERIES 5 minutes SINCE 30 minutes ago

widgets.title: API Gateway availability and error rates (%)
widgets.coverage_note: Availability excludes 4xx responses and uses 100 × (Count − 5XXError) / Count. No requests produce no availability claim; verify provider fields before apply.
widgets.nrql: FROM ApiGatewaySample SELECT 100 * (sum(provider.count) - sum(provider.5xxError)) / sum(provider.count) AS 'availability', 100 * sum(provider.4xxError) / sum(provider.count) AS '4xx error rate', 100 * sum(provider.5xxError) / sum(provider.count) AS '5xx error rate' WHERE stage = 'hml' TIMESERIES 5 minutes SINCE 30 minutes ago

widgets.title: API Gateway latency (milliseconds)
widgets.coverage_note: Provider attribute names and units require live schema verification.
widgets.nrql: FROM ApiGatewaySample SELECT average(provider.latency), average(provider.integrationLatency) WHERE stage = 'hml' TIMESERIES 5 minutes SINCE 30 minutes ago

widgets.title: lambda-auth errors, throttles and duration (count/ms)
widgets.coverage_note: Cold starts are intentionally omitted until lambda-auth instrumentation is verified.
widgets.nrql: FROM ServerlessSample SELECT sum(provider.invocations), sum(provider.errors), sum(provider.throttles), average(provider.duration) WHERE provider.functionName = 'lambda-auth-hml' TIMESERIES 5 minutes SINCE 30 minutes ago

widgets.title: Kubernetes pod CPU and memory (cores/bytes)
widgets.nrql: FROM K8sPodSample SELECT latest(cpuUsedCores), latest(memoryWorkingSetBytes) WHERE clusterName = 'auto-shop-hml' AND namespaceName = 'auto-shop-hml' FACET deploymentName TIMESERIES SINCE 30 minutes ago

widgets.title: Kubernetes pods not ready (count)
widgets.nrql: FROM K8sPodSample SELECT filter(uniqueCount(podName), WHERE isReady = false) WHERE clusterName = 'auto-shop-hml' AND namespaceName = 'auto-shop-hml' SINCE 30 minutes ago

widgets.title: Kubernetes container restart counters (count)
widgets.coverage_note: Counters are faceted; they are never summed across containers.
widgets.nrql: FROM K8sContainerSample SELECT max(restartCount) WHERE clusterName = 'auto-shop-hml' AND namespaceName = 'auto-shop-hml' FACET deploymentName, podName, containerName TIMESERIES SINCE 30 minutes ago

widgets.title: Kubernetes HPA desired/current replicas (replicas)
widgets.nrql: FROM K8sHpaSample SELECT latest(currentReplicas), latest(desiredReplicas) WHERE clusterName = 'auto-shop-hml' AND namespaceName = 'auto-shop-hml' FACET displayName TIMESERIES SINCE 30 minutes ago
